segments.name: Fluid Delivery Subsystems and Components
segments.description: Design, engineering and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components for semiconductor capital equipment and other industries.
segments.evidence: We are a leader in the design, engineering and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components primarily for semiconductor capital equipment, as well as other industries such as defense/aerospace and medical.

revenueModel.text: OEM customers engaged in manufacturing semiconductor capital equipment pay for design, engineering, and manufacturing of fluid delivery subsystems and components.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide fluid delivery solutions, subsystems, and complex machined components to our customers, supporting their most advanced products.
